title: rhododendron neriiflorum subsp. phoenicodum
intro: Rhododendron neriiflorum subsp. phoenicodum, commonly known as Phoenicodendron neriiflorum, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron neriiflorum subsp. phoenicodum include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
